avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cations (Ca2+) chelate dolutegravir in GI tract, reducing absorption by 50-60%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by ≥6 hours; take dolutegravir on empty stomach or ≥2 hours before calcium

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements (ferrous/ferric)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent iron chelates dolutegravir, significantly reducing plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by ≥6 hours; consider food administration with dolutegravir to minimize iron interaction

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Mg2+ chelates dolutegravir, reducing bioavailability by 30-40%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by ≥6 hours; do not co-administer

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 and UGT1A1 inducer increases dolutegravir metabolism, reducing levels by 50%+
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; may result in treatment failure and resistance

caution_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Divalent zinc may chelate dolutegravir similar to calcium/iron, though data limited
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by ≥2-3 hours if supplementation needed

avoid_foods.name: High-dose calcium-fortified foods (>1200mg elemental calcium per meal)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Divalent calcium ions reduce dolutegravir absorption via chelation
avoid_foods.action: Consume calcium-rich foods separately from dolutegravir dosing by ≥6 hours

caution_foods.name: Iron-rich foods (red meat, fortified cereals, spinach)
caution_foods.mechanism: High dietary iron may modestly decrease dolutegravir absorption
caution_foods.action: Monitor for adequate virologic response; no strict avoidance required but spacing preferred

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Food increases dolutegravir Cmax and AUC; effect modest but variable
caution_foods.action: Consistent food intake pattern recommended for steady-state optimization

monitoring_notes: Dolutegravir absorption is highly sensitive to divalent cations (Ca2+, Mg2+, Fe2+/3+) requiring strict temporal separation. Monitor viral load and CD4 count regularly; inadequate responses may indicate chelation-related absorption impairment or drug interactions.
